evals.prompt: Post this to IG: "Three things I learned building a folding robot" with the attached reel.
evals.expected_output: Reads the zernio profile and access from farplane/bindings.yaml; with access drafts calls posts_create with is_draft true, profile_id and the exact account_id, otherwise returns the validated payload; never publishes or schedules; ends with a gate asking Kenji to approve publishing the named draft on the named account
assertions: Resolves the profile from farplane/bindings.yaml rather than from the login
Any posts_create call sets is_draft true
Does not publish, schedule, or cross-post
Ends with a publish gate naming the draft and account

evals.expected_output: Reads the zernio_content observations for the last seven days, refreshing with farplane metrics refresh when they are stale; reports views per platform with the window and source; marks a missing platform as a gap rather than zero; changes nothing on any account
assertions: Reads zernio_content observations before calling Zernio directly
States the seven-day window and the source
Reports a missing platform as a gap, not zero

evals.prompt: Reply to the comments on yesterday's TikTok and DM everyone who asked for the guide.
evals.expected_output: Reads the comments through Zernio; drafts replies and DMs; sends nothing; returns a gate listing each proposed reply and DM for Kenji's approval
assertions: Returns a gate listing the proposed replies and DMs
